text:
Alex: Quick heads-up — we need to rebalance RICE scores for the upcoming quarter. Three priority customer asks landed this morning and they push on different levers (cost reduction, observability, dedicated routing). Can we do a quick async triage?
Julie: happy to. Can you list the asks and current RICEs?
Alex: Sure — summarized: 1) Predictive batching config UI (customer A) — current R:6 I:8 C:4 E:3 2) Dedicated routing SLA + fallbacks (customer B/enterprise) — R:9 I:7 C:8 E:5 3) Telemetry retention export + query interface (platform teams) — R:5 I:6 C:3 E:2
Sam: looks like customer B is highest reach but high cost. We also have dependancies with Dedicated rollout timeline.
Priya: question — are we scoring "reach" consistent across hosted/dedicated customers? Some enterprise deals count more for revenue but fewer seats. Should R reflect ARR impact not just user count?
Connor: I vote yes — for this quarter we should weight ARR impact x1.5 for Dedicated-related asks. Otherwise we under-index enterprise value.
Julie: we didn't agree to weighting changes last cycle. If we change the formula mid-quarter we need to document it and re-score everything or it's unfair.
Alex: Agreed re-document. Proposal: keep base RICE method but add a separate "ARR multiplier" tag that affects roadmap prioritization only for Dedicated lane. That way Hosted lanes unchanged. Thoughts?
Sam: pragmatic. Also think sequencing matters — UI for predictive batching unlocks cost savings that reduce objections for Dedicated SLA. Maybe do batching first with a canary to major customers.
Priya: +1 on sequencing. Launch criteria for predictive batching should include: 1) stable 95th pct latency under target at 10k qps 2) cost reduction >=10% on test workload 3) docs + quickstart.
Connor: For Dedicated routing SLA: can we commit to fallback policy that routes to compatible cheaper model when capacity constrained? That reduces risk of full failure and lowers SLO exposure. If yes, C (cost) might be lower.
Alex: We can define fallback policy as part of the feature, yes. That would shift C from 8->6 maybe. Need eng estimate.
Julie: Engineering note: fallback is doable but obvs needs tests. Effort will be split across runtime and routing policy. E: +2 weeks if scoped minimal.
Sam: Can we propose a quick re-score table? I'll drop numbers below and we can thumbs up/down:

```
Feature | Reach | Impact | Confidence | Effort | ARR_mult | Notes
Predictive batching UI | 6 | 8 | 4 | 3 | 1.0 | unlocks cost saving
Dedicated routing SLA | 9 | 7 | 6 | 5 | 1.5 | enterprise ARR weight
Telemetry export/query | 5 | 6 | 3 | 2 | 1.0 | platform enabler
```
Priya: small nit — confidence for dedicated should be 5 not 6 given infra unknowns.
Alex: updated. Also proposal for sequencing: Predictive batching -> Telemetry export (helps observability of savings) -> Dedicated SLA gradual rollout. That order reduces risk and proves value.
Connor: if we accept that, then Dedicated SLA moves down despite high R. I'm ok with that given commercial runway.
Julie: thumbs up for sequencing. Action items: Alex to create a short spec for predictive batching (launch criteria + canary plan), Sam to re-score with ARR multiplier and publish the new RICE sheet, Priya to draft telemetry query UX minimum, Connor to scope fallback policy with runtime.
Alex: will do. Target: have rescores and specs by EOD Fri. @product-bot can you create an epic for each and add owners?
product-bot: Created epics P-3241 (predictive-batching), P-3242 (telemetry-exports), P-3243 (dedicated-routing-sla) and added assignees Alex, Priya, Connor.
Sam: thanks. If anyone wants to push back on ARR multiplier we should surface to leadership before Friday.
Julie: I'll surface briefly in our PM sync tomorrow.
Priya: quick clarification — can we mark the predictive batching UI as "beta" for Hosted first? reduces rollout risk and gives data for Dedicated ask.
Alex: yes — beta hosted then dedicated opt-in. That satisfies both product and sales.
Connor: cool. I'll start rough effort estimates and post in the sheet.
Alex: great work team. Short follow-up: include explicit launch criteria in the spec (latency, cost delta, error budget impact, docs). Thanks all. :thumbsup:
